listings.title: Bluebonnet Nutrition Sunfiber, 7.4 oz
bullets: GENTLE GUT SUPPORT –Bluebonnet’s Sunfiber Powder delivers 6 grams of plant-based dietary fiber from partially hydrolyzed guar gum to help support bowel regularity while also providing prebiotic benefits for gastrointestinal health. This soluble and slow-fermenting fiber is well tolerated and suitable for those following a low-FODMAP diet.*

PREBIOTIC BENEFITS– Adding prebiotic fiber to your diet stimulates the growth of good bacteria so they can thrive and also suppresses the growth of bad bacteria, promoting an optimal environment for good digestive health, all the while easing bloating and gas. *

PLANT-BASED SOLUBLE FIBER - Bluebonnet’s Sunfiber Powder delivers 6 grams of soluble and slow-fermenting plant-sourced fiber that is highly absorbable and bioavailable! This unflavored, colorless, and odorless plant based prebiotic soluble fiber dissolves instantly with water or any liquid, making it a breeze to support your digestion with your favorite beverage! *

ONLY THE BEST INGREDIENTS - Made with premium raw materials to produce high quality supplements for maximum bioavailability and absorption to help achieve the desired health benefits. Each ingredient in our formulas has undergone analytical testing to verify they meet specifications for identity, purity, and potency.

ECO-FRIENDLY PRODUCTS - Bluebonnet works directly with growers, farmers and suppliers to ensure you and your family will get the best whole-food ingredients possible. This product is Non-GMO Project Verified, Low-FODMAP Certified, Vegan, Kosher Certified, Gluten-Free, Soy-Free, Milk-Free and more! Made without artificially derived colors, flavors or sweeteners and unnecessary binders, fillers or additives to maintain nutrient integrity. Delivered in recyclable packaging.
